summary.intent: Run a cryptographic security review on the planning documents committed in PR #295 of the cipher-box repo, specifically reviewing the phase 19.1 plans for extracting the core crypto SDK as a shared package.
summary.outcome: The review was scoped to planning/documentation files (not implementation code), with the assistant reading all 19.1 phase plan files and spawning an agent to analyze the SDK extraction plans for security implications. Several planning files were modified as a result.

repo: The project follows a strict zero-knowledge architecture: server never has access to plaintext or unencrypted keys
IPNS private keys must be encrypted with a TEE public key before transmission; TEE decrypts, signs, and immediately discards
Key hierarchy is defined as rootFolderKey → folderKey → fileKey
Phase 19.1 is focused on extracting the core crypto SDK into a shared package, suggesting a monorepo or multi-package architecture
Planning documents live under .planning/phases/[phase-id]/ with a consistent naming convention: CONTEXT, RESEARCH, VALIDATION, and numbered PLAN files
workflow: The security:review command scopes the review before reading files, using AskUserQuestion to select between specific files, recent changes, phase code, or full audit
The command explicitly avoids making edits — review is read-only, producing only a report artifact
Security review reports are written to .planning/security/REVIEW-[timestamp].md
The review command reads CLAUDE.md security rules as a compliance baseline before analyzing code

friction: The review was applied to planning/documentation files rather than implementation code, limiting the depth of cryptographic correctness analysis since no actual crypto operations were present to audit
The transcript does not show the final report output or what specific security findings (if any) were generated from the agent review
open_items: The actual crypto implementation files that will be split into the shared SDK package have not been reviewed — a follow-up security:review on the implementation code should be done once phase 19.1 is implemented
It is unclear whether the shared SDK package will run in browser (Web Crypto API) or Node.js environments — the security review should verify the correct crypto primitives are used per environment
The modifications to .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/ROADMAP.md, and .planning/STATE.md were not shown — these changes should be verified to not inadvertently weaken security requirements
